components.name: Local Status Chip
components.description: Noninteractive notation confirming that the product runs locally.
components.css: .ds-local-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.36rem 0.7rem; border: 1px solid #cbd8e8; border-radius: 999px; color: #1559bc; background: #f7faff; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 650; } .ds-local-status__dot { width: 0.48rem; height: 0.48rem; border-radius: 50%; background: #1769e0; }

components.name: Conversation Stage
components.description: A clear subtitle-safe field for conversational copy.
components.html: Your conversation will appear here
components.css: .ds-stage { position: relative; display: grid; place-items: center; min-height: 12rem; overflow: hidden; background: #ffffff; } .ds-stage p { max-width: 34rem; margin: 0; padding: 2rem; color: #30415a; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: clamp(1.05rem, 2.2vw, 1.32rem); font-weight: 520; line-height: 1.4; letter-spacing: -0.018em; text-align: center; text-wrap: balance; } .ds-stage__mark { position: absolute; width: 1.55rem; height: 1.55rem; border-color: #aec0d8; border-style: solid; } .ds-stage__mark--tl { top: 1.5rem; left: 1.5rem; border-width: 1px 0 0 1px; } .ds-stage__mark--tc, .ds-stage__mark--bc { left: 50%; width: 1px; height: 1rem; border-width: 0 0 0 1px; transform: translateX(-50%); } .ds-stage__mark--tc { top: 1.5rem; } .ds-stage__mark--tr { top: 1.5rem; right: 1.5rem; border-width: 1px 1px 0 0; } .ds-stage__mark--bl { bottom: 1.5rem; left: 1.5rem; border-width: 0 0 1px 1px; } .ds-stage__mark--bc { bottom: 1.5rem; } .ds-stage__mark--br { right: 1.5rem; bottom: 1.5rem; border-width: 0 1px 1px 0; }

components.name: Disabled Talk Control
components.description: The broad voice action shown honestly before voice input is connected.
components.css: .ds-talk-control { display: grid; gap: 0.28rem; width: min(100%, 70rem); min-height: 5.2rem; padding: 1rem 1.5rem; border: 1px solid #cbd5e2; border-radius: 12px; color: #647187; background: #e9eef5; box-shadow: 0 8px 22px rgb(35 57 84 / 7%); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; text-align: center; cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 1; } .ds-talk-control__label { font-size: clamp(1.12rem, 2.5vw, 1.48rem); font-weight: 680; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-talk-control__hint { color: #738096; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 470; }

components.name: System Diagnostics — Checking
components.description: The live native-runtime ledger while the desktop health check is pending.
components.css: .ds-diagnostics { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.65rem; min-height: 4.5rem; padding: 0.75rem clamp(1.25rem, 3vw, 2.5rem); border-top: 1px solid #d8e0eb; color: #25374f; background: #fbfcfe; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-diagnostics strong { padding-right: 1.15rem; border-right: 1px solid #c8d2df; color: #1769e0; font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 720; } .ds-diagnostics__checking { flex: 0 0 auto; width: 0.55rem; height: 0.55rem; border: 2px solid #708099; border-right-color: transparent; border-radius: 50%; animation: ds-runtime-check 900ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) infinite; } .ds-diagnostics__message { font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 560; } @keyframes ds-runtime-check { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-diagnostics__checking { animation: none; border-right-color: #708099; } }

components.name: System Diagnostics — Ready
components.description: The successful runtime state with compact platform metadata.
components.html: SystemDesktop runtime readymacOS · arm64
components.css: .ds-diagnostics-ready { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.65rem; min-height: 4.5rem; padding: 0.75rem clamp(1.25rem, 3vw, 2.5rem); border-top: 1px solid #d8e0eb; color: #25374f; background: #fbfcfe; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-diagnostics-ready strong { padding-right: 1.15rem; border-right: 1px solid #c8d2df; color: #1769e0; font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 720; } .ds-diagnostics-ready__mark { width: 0.55rem; height: 0.55rem; border: 2px solid #277557; border-radius: 50%; background: #277557; } .ds-diagnostics-ready__message { font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 560; } .ds-diagnostics-ready__meta { margin-left: auto; color: #617087; font-size: 0.76rem; }

components.description: The unavailable runtime state with direct recovery and inspectable technical detail.

components.css: .ds-diagnostics-error { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.65rem; min-height: 4.5rem; padding: 0.75rem clamp(1.25rem, 3vw, 2.5rem); border-top: 1px solid #d8e0eb; color: #25374f; background: #fbfcfe; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-diagnostics-error strong { padding-right: 1.15rem; border-right: 1px solid #c8d2df; color: #1769e0; font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 720; } .ds-diagnostics-error__mark { width: 0.55rem; height: 0.55rem; border: 2px solid #a5363f; border-radius: 2px; background: #a5363f; } .ds-diagnostics-error__message { font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 560; } .ds-diagnostics-error__recovery, .ds-diagnostics-error details { color: #a5363f; font-size: 0.76rem; } .ds-diagnostics-error__recovery { margin-left: auto; } .ds-diagnostics-error details { position: relative; } .ds-diagnostics-error summary { color: #7f3138; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-diagnostics-error code { position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: calc(100% + 0.6rem); width: min(30rem, 70vw); padding: 0.65rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid #e2bcc0; border-radius: 8px; color: #7f3138; background: #fff8f8; box-shadow: 0 8px 22px rgb(67 27 31 / 10%); line-height: 1.4; white-space: normal; }

narrative.overview:
English Coach should feel like a quiet place to rehearse a spoken line: cool, private, attentive, and free of generic chat-product spectacle. The visual system borrows the restraint of a subtitle-safe frame—deep ink, pale fields, precise notation, and generous calm—while keeping the product's local runtime state legible.

Conversation remains visually primary and coaching remains secondary. Native macOS typography, thin rules, and a small signal-blue vocabulary make the interface feel direct rather than branded for its own sake; semantic green and red appear only when runtime health requires them.
keyCharacteristics: Cool white and blue-gray tonal layering.
Deep navy text with sparing signal-blue notation.
Thin rules and frame marks instead of nested cards.
Calm, explicit runtime feedback with reduced-motion support.

rules.name: The Signal, Not Decoration Rule
rules.body: Blue identifies local product structure; green and red report runtime truth. None of the three colors is ambient decoration.

rules.name: The Clearest Field Rule
rules.body: Conversation content gets the cleanest white surface so it remains visually primary.

rules.name: The Native Voice Rule
rules.body: Use the platform sans stack throughout; hierarchy comes from scale, weight, and placement rather than decorative font switching.

rules.name: The Subtitle Restraint Rule
rules.body: Reserve centered, balanced, slightly tightened copy for the conversational voice—not for every piece of interface chrome.

rules.name: The Stable Topology Rule
rules.body: Responsive changes compress and wrap; they do not reorder the learner's task or hide runtime truth.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Region boundaries come from tone and one-pixel rules. Shadows belong only to a control or temporary disclosure that must separate from its immediate surface.

rules.name: The Open Frame Rule
rules.body: Use sparse corner or center notation when a quiet area needs definition; avoid enclosing important content in another card by default.

dos: Do keep conversation on the clearest surface and runtime coaching or diagnostics in subordinate chrome.
Do use thin cool-gray rules, restrained blue notation, and native system typography to establish hierarchy.
Do preserve visible checking, ready, and error states, including a nonanimated reduced-motion fallback.
Do compress spacing and wrap secondary diagnostics in compact windows without changing task order.
donts: Don't introduce generic chat bubbles, AI gradients, glowing assistant effects, or ornamental brand imagery.
Don't use semantic green or red outside runtime health and recovery states.
Don't turn each region into a floating rounded card; tonal fields and rules are the default structure.
Don't promote the current surface's row composition into a system-wide template; keep surface composition in its surface brief.
